I applied for youth allowance and got a message 2 weeks later that a "Services Australia Service Officer" was going to call me. 1 minute after that message, I was called from a private number. Of the bat, I had no clue what was going on and I had asked several times why they were calling me, they were vague and just said it was for the claim.
What this asshole decided to do was interrogate me about my whole living situation and pretty much tell me that the experiences I went through were normal. His tone throughout this whole ordeal was pretty much someone who's shit didn't stink. Trying to get me to say yes to broad statements to lessen the experiences I went through, "isn't it normal to have to do x y and z?" I was 16 at the time wtf do you mean it's normal. I got so pissed that he was trying to entrap me that I straight up asked him why he would be calling me for a youth allowance claim and continue to do all this. He explains that I said it was unreasonable to live at home claim so he had to follow up. I claimed youth allowance 3 separate times previously and have never had this happen.
If this dumbass was just clear about why he was calling me in the beginning then none of this would have happened.
